author: fester
body: Spans are not in the wire format. The walkers populate every span field with synthetic-span; downstream emitters that don't read span (CSharpEmitter et al.) work unchanged.

author: fester
body: Single-pass tokenizer. Returns list of tokens in source order. White space (CCE space, LF) separates tokens; '(' and ')' are structural; '"' begins a string with backslash escapes.

author: fester
body: Stack-based parser. parse-sexp returns one SExp and the next token index. The top-level form is always a single SExp (the chapter).

author: fester
body: Coercions used pervasively by walkers. SExp is sum-typed but every walker knows the expected shape -- these helpers extract values while falling back to safe defaults so a malformed input degrades rather than crashes.

author: fester
body: Bare atom forms map to nullary type variants. Paren forms have an atom head plus payload; dispatch on head atom.

author: fester
body: The row is optional and trails the two type positions, so IR text emitted before the row was published parses to the same empty row it always did. Every arrow used to be rebuilt as empty-row unconditionally, which made the effect claim unrecoverable on this side even once the emitter published it.

author: fester
body: The chapter header carries one (pb anchor text) per prose block and one (ann kind target body) per annotation. A block's transition and template are re-derivable from its text and are not sent, so they read back as PtNone and PtNoTemplate; the offset ordered the blocks against the defs before they were written and is not sent either.
